_comment: THE TRANSACTIONAL MOMENTS, AND THE ONLY PLACE THEY ARE DEFINED.
Each entry names a moment the storefront can ask the relay to send. The
relay reads this through feed/messages.json and refuses any intent that is
not here, so a content id never travels in a request from a page.
THE BODY LIVES BESIDE THIS FILE rather than in the panel. Dengage accepts a
subject and a whole HTML body on the send call, measured on 18 September
2026, so a content created in the panel and left empty works as long as
Transactional content is ticked. That keeps every template in this
repository, under review, next to the relay that fills it, and it turns a
new moment into one empty content in the panel rather than a paste and a
round of checking.
Pasting a body into the panel instead still works and is the better choice
for anything a non developer should be able to change mid quarter: a
subject or a body on the call simply wins, so leaving html null here hands
that moment back to the panel.
NO TAG IN ANY BODY CARRIES LOGIC. An expression referring to a key the call
did not pass prints its own source code into the delivered message, so
every default and every sentence that varies is composed by the relay and
printed with a plain tag. TRANSACTIONAL-TRIGGERS.md section 6 has the
measurements.

A SUBJECT MAY CARRY {key} PLACEHOLDERS, and only those. The relay fills each one from the same vocabulary the body prints, so a subject and a body can never disagree, and an unknown key is left alone rather than printed as a broken tag.

intents.label: Exit intent, basket has items
intents.subject: Your basket at {store_name} is still here
